title: 第一卷 第23章 不要乱碰男子的腰带第一卷 第24章 她没有欲念全是对艺术的欣赏
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
;;
谢寒声的住处，门外两个人在风中凌乱，门内一个人在好奇男色，还有一个人昏迷不自知。
终于，伴随着一声巨响，王师弟冲进了房门。
外面，兰芳大声警告：“禽兽，放开二师兄！”
上一次发生这种禽兽之事的时候，还是上一次。
兰芳至今还记得，那天夜里二师兄身中魔气躺着地上，也是昏迷不醒，舒晩昭趴在他身上啪啪啪打他的脸。
她不敢想，二师兄穿衣服舒晩昭都乱来，此次没穿衣服，这不羊入虎口吗？
她不方便进屋看，背过身体指挥王师弟。
“快快快，把舒晩昭从二师兄身上扒下来，别忘了让她给二师兄吃丹药。”
进屋的王师弟和舒晩昭面面相觑。
他尴尬地挠挠头，“兰师姐，舒师姐没趴在二师兄身上。”
兰芳：“……”这不对吧？
但里面的情况她不方便看，抓心挠肝地等着。
舒晩昭有些无语自己在卧龙宗到底是什么个形象。
被人误解属实心酸，她幽幽叹气，背着小手慢悠悠走到床边，当着王师弟的面掰开谢寒声的捏下巴，塞丹药，动作一气呵成。
幸亏修真界的丹药入口即化，她拍了拍手，“他怎么那么穷，连疗伤的丹药都没有。”
普通弟子没有丹药就算了，为什么谢寒声会没有呢？
况且谢寒声是做任务狂魔，腰包里应该很有钱才是。
王师弟：“我也不太清楚，二师兄生活拮据，倒是每个月都要到山下待几日，应该有其他开销。”
原著故事随着女主而展开，一些细节很容易被忽略，系统没有提过，应该是不重要的剧情。

舒晩昭摩挲了一下下巴，没有说话，随手将剩下的丹药交给王师弟：“留着给他吃，我有事先走了。”
“多谢师姐。”
收拾好一切，舒晩昭不仅没有偷成丹药，反而第二天早上迟到了。
等她到来，沈长安的课程已经讲了一半。
她穿着浅蓝色的衣裙，头顶的簪子插得叮叮当当，趴在门口探头探脑，一时之间不知道该不该进去。
坐在首位上的男子衣袂逶迤，润白的指尖执着深蓝色的古籍，嗓音温润随和，侃侃而谈。
室内除了他的声音，寂静一片，便是此时，有人发现了她，一个个悄咪咪向门口投去目光。
沈长安的指尖微屈，声音不停，眼神都没飘过去一下，衣袖拂过。
一阵风刮过，大门嘭地一下关上，舒晩昭一个弹跳逃离，差点碰了一鼻子灰。
她摸摸鼻子，今天的课堂大概是进不去了，不用猜都能知道那些弟子肯定在心里嘲讽她，等她受罚。
她怂唧唧地蹲在墙角种蘑菇，暗自思索逃跑的可能性。
可惜了，躲得了和尚躲不了庙，被抓回来只会更惨。

Xie Hansheng's residence, two people outside the door were messy in the wind, one person inside the door was curious about male sex, and another person was unconscious.
Finally, with a loud noise, Junior Brother Wang rushed into the door.
Outside, Lan Fang warned loudly: "Beast, let go of Second Senior Brother!"
The last time something like this happened to an animal was the last time.
Lan Fang still remembers that night when the second senior brother was lying on the ground unconscious due to demonic aura, and Shu Mizhao lay on top of him and slapped him in the face.
She didn't dare to think that the second senior brother, Shu Mingzhao, was messing around even when he was wearing clothes. This time he didn't wear clothes. Wouldn't this be a sheep in a tiger's mouth?
It was not convenient for her to enter the room and watch, so she turned her back to command Junior Brother Wang.
"Quick, quick, get Shu Mingzhao off the second senior brother. Don't forget to ask her to give the second senior brother the elixir."
Junior Brother Wang and Shu Manzhao looked at each other in confusion when they entered the room.
He scratched his head in embarrassment, "Senior Sister Lan, Senior Sister Shu is not lying on top of Second Senior Brother."
Lan Fang: "..." Isn't this right?
But it was not convenient for her to see what was going on inside, so she waited anxiously.
Shu Mingzhao was a little speechless about what kind of image he had in Wolong Sect.
It was really sad to be misunderstood. She sighed quietly, walked slowly to the bedside with her little hands behind her back, opened Xie Hansheng's chin in front of Junior Brother Wang, and stuffed the elixir, all in one movement.
Fortunately, the elixirs from the cultivation world melted in her mouth. She clapped her hands and said, "Why is he so poor? He doesn't even have elixirs for healing."
It’s okay if ordinary disciples don’t have any elixirs. Why doesn’t Xie Hansheng not have any?
Besides, Xie Hansheng is a task maniac, so he should have a lot of money in his pocket.
Junior Brother Wang: "I'm not sure. Second Senior Brother lives in a tight situation, but he has to go to the mountain for a few days every month. He should have other expenses."
The original story unfolds with the heroine, and some details are easily overlooked. The system has not mentioned it, and it should be an unimportant plot.
Shu Zhaozhao rubbed his chin, said nothing, and handed the remaining elixir to Junior Brother Wang: "Keep it for him to eat. I have to leave beforehand."
"Thank you, senior sister."
After packing everything, Shu Mingzhao not only failed to steal the elixir, but was late the next morning.
By the time she arrived, Shen Changan had already finished half of his course.
She was wearing a light blue dress, with a jingling hairpin on her head. She lay at the door and poked her head around, wondering for a moment whether she should go in or not.
The man sitting at the top of the table was dressed in ragged clothes, holding a dark blue ancient book on his white fingertips. His voice was gentle and easy-going, and he was talking eloquently.
Except for his voice, there was silence in the room. At this moment, someone noticed her, and they all quietly cast their eyes towards the door.
Shen Changan's fingertips were slightly bent, and he kept speaking, without even looking away, brushing his sleeves.
A gust of wind blew, and the door slammed shut. Shu Mizhao jumped to escape, almost getting hurt.
She touched her nose. She probably wouldn't be able to enter today's class. She didn't have to guess to know that those disciples must be mocking her in their hearts and waiting for her to be punished.
She squatted in the corner and planted mushrooms, thinking secretly about the possibility of escaping.
It's a pity that the monk can't hide in the temple. If he is caught, it will only be worse.
